name: Lindy
freeTierNote: No permanent free tier — 7-day trial credits (check official pricing).
bestFor: Hosted “AI employees” for email and CRM busywork
skipIf: You need transparent, versioned workflows you can diff in git
keyFeatures: Hosted no-code AI agents for inbox and calendar
Prebuilt templates for CRM and meeting follow-ups
limitations: Opaque execution graph compared with n8n
Requires careful permission scoping on email/CRM access
summary: A no-code agent platform. Convenient. Opaque compared with n8n.
body: Lindy sells the fantasy of an employee. Sometimes that is email triage. Sometimes it is a loop that books the wrong meeting. We list it because search demand for AI agents is real, and we would rather you see a named vendor than a Twitter demo. Prefer n8n if you want to own the graph. Public site reviewed 16 Sep 2026.
notes: Start with one workflow and a human approval step
Not a replacement for a junior engineer
